subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction was vacated on appeal in June 2026.

summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud in November 2023 and sentenced in March 2024; as of mid‑2026 his conviction remained on appeal and had not been vacated. No credible reports indicate his conviction was overturned in June 2026.
